config.title: OpenCode TUI for VS Code
cfg.opencodePath.desc: Path to opencode. E.g. 'C:/Users/ilgiz/AppData/Local/OpenCode/opencode.exe', 'opencode.cmd', or just 'opencode'.
cfg.serverPort.desc: Port for opencode server. 0 = random available port.
cfg.serverMode.desc: Server mode: 'embedded' (default) runs the TUI with its own private server; 'separate' runs a headless 'opencode serve' plus an attached TUI; 'external' attaches to a server you launched yourself (extra memory).
cfg.serverAddress.desc: Address of an externally launched 'opencode serve', e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096. Used only in 'external' mode. Stored in settings, reused across sessions.
cfg.serverPassword.desc: Password of the external server (OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD). Empty = the server needs no password.
cmd.toggleFocus.title: Toggle OpenCode Focus
cfg.leaderChords.desc: Leader chord characters to intercept (e.g. ["n","m","l"]). Empty = use tui.json or built-in defaults.
cfg.ctrlASelectAll.desc: Redirect Ctrl+A to select-all in the input field instead of sending cursor-home to the terminal.
cfg.enterSendsMessage.desc: When ON: Enter sends message, Shift+Enter adds newline. When OFF: Enter adds newline, Shift+Enter sends message.
cfg.orphanCleanup.startupScan.desc: Scan for orphan opencode processes when the extension activates.
cfg.orphanCleanup.watchdog.desc: Spawn a detached process that monitors extension host health and cleans up orphan processes on crash or kill.
